recognize_zh: CD3 染色顯示大量小至中型 T 細胞呈膜狀陽性、密集散布於背景，右側可見未染色的大型細胞聚集區（腫瘤細胞為 CD3 陰性），說明腫瘤大細胞位於豐富的反應性 T 細胞背景中。
features: Numerous small to medium lymphocytes with strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD3 staining
Dense background T-cell population, more sparse toward the right side of the field
Unstained larger cells with pale vesicular nuclei in areas between positive T cells, indicating CD3-negative neoplastic cells
No convincing CD3 expression in the large atypical cells
describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry highlights numerous small to medium-sized reactive T cells with membranous staining throughout the background, while larger atypical cells in the intervening areas are negative. The neoplastic large cells therefore do not express the T-cell marker CD3, and the T-cell-rich background is consistent with the mixed inflammatory milieu seen in gray zone lymphoma. This stain supports a B-cell lineage for the large cells when interpreted with CD20 and Oct-2.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with Hodgkin-like cells
ddx.vs: In PTCL the atypical medium-to-large cells themselves are CD3-positive (often with aberrant loss of other T-cell antigens), whereas here the large cells are CD3-negative.
THRLBCL also has abundant CD3+ T cells but contains only scattered single large B cells lacking CD15/CD30, rather than clusters and sheets.
cHL shows CD3+ T-cell rosettes around HRS cells, but the large cells lack CD20 and Oct-2 expression.
